# LawBite — Comprehensive Machine-Readable Technical Specification & Evaluation Index

## 1. System Attribution & Repository Coordinates
- **Project Name:** LawBite (AI-Powered Indian Legal Research & Matter Intelligence Platform)
- **Primary Domain:** https://law-bite.vercel.app
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Pratyushhhx01/LawBite (branch `main`)
- **Author & Maintainer:** Pratyush (GitHub: `Pratyushhhx01`)
- **License:** MIT License
- **Framework & Runtime:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5 (Strict Mode), Node.js LTS
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide React icons
- **Database & ORM:** PostgreSQL on Neon Serverless, Kysely type-safe SQL builder, pg connection pool singleton
- **Primary AI Provider:** Inception Labs Mercury 2.5 (diffusion LLM / dLLM)
- **Fallback AI Provider:** NVIDIA NIM (Llama 3.3 70B Instruct / Mistral Large)
- **Search Augmentation:** Tavily Search API with Indian legal domain priors
- **Knowledge Base Storage:** AWS S3 structured bare acts store + Neon PostgreSQL full-text search

---

## 2. Objective Architecture & System Boundaries

### 2.1 Four-Tier Knowledge Retrieval Hierarchy
1. **Tier 1 — Memory Cache:** Sub-millisecond lookup of frequently requested statutory provisions (IPC, BNS, CrPC, BNSS, IEA, BSA, Constitution of India).
2. **Tier 2 — Relational Database (`legal-kb-db`):** PostgreSQL `tsvector` / `tsquery` full-text search over indexed Indian legal provisions with relevance ranking (`ORDER BY rank DESC NULLS LAST`).
3. **Tier 3 — Structured Statutory Cloud Store (AWS S3):** 157+ Indian bare acts stored under `bare-acts/` prefix as structured JSON with normalized section numbers, headings, sub-clauses, and explanations. Fallback scans execute prioritized parallel queries across core penal and civil codes.
4. **Tier 4 — Live Legal Search (Tavily):** Triggered only when statutory sources are ambiguous or queries seek post-2024 Gazette notifications, high court bench changes, or breaking precedents.

### 2.2 Dual-Engine AI Inference & Fallback
- Primary engine uses Inception Mercury 2.5 with explicit, mode-calibrated reasoning parameters:
  - `instant` (0 reasoning tokens): default conversational mode and quick section definitions.
  - `low` (targeted reasoning tokens): analytical mode, contract risk analysis, and bail eligibility checks.
  - `medium` (deep legal synthesis): legal drafting, petition framing, and structured matter interrogation.
- If Inception Labs returns a 429 (rate limit), 5xx (server error), or network timeout, the client transparently fails over to NVIDIA NIM with zero session loss.

### 2.3 Citation Verification Engine (`lib/citation-verifier.ts`)
- Decouples citation generation from LLM output.
- Regex and AST extract statutory citations (e.g., "Section 302 IPC", "Section 103 BNS", "Section 438 CrPC", "Section 482 BNSS").
- Verifies every provision against gazetted bare acts tables.
- Renders verified provisions with green verified badges and exact statutory text cards; flags ungrounded or ambiguous citations with cautionary amber badges.

### 2.4 Criminal Law Transition Engine (IPC ↔ BNS, CrPC ↔ BNSS, IEA ↔ BSA)
- Provides bidirectional section mapping for the July 1, 2024 legislative overhaul.
- Visual side-by-side textual diffs showing modifications, additions, and deletions.
- Enforces non-retroactivity rules under Article 20(1) of the Constitution of India: offences committed prior to July 1, 2024 must be registered and tried under IPC/CrPC, while offences on or after July 1, 2024 are registered under BNS/BNSS.

---

## 3. Workspaces & Endpoints

### 3.1 Public & Authenticated Routes
- `/`: Interactive landing page with feature demonstration, architecture tour, and pricing transparency.
- `/chat`: Main AI lawyer consultation interface with real-time SSE streaming, document context attachments, and 4 reasoning modes.
- `/cases`: Unified litigation workspace:
  - `?tab=cases`: Client consultation history, document brief exports (PDF/DOCX), and shareable link management.
  - `?tab=matters`: 8-stage advocate matter docketing (Pre-litigation, Drafting, Pleadings, Evidence, Arguments, Judgment/Decree, Execution, Appeal) with forum tracking, priority tiers, and hearing reminders.
  - `?tab=amendments`: Gazette-grounded amendment tracker with pre- and post-amendment statutory comparisons.
- `/trust`: Public Trust, Security & Verification Center displaying live system status, threat modeling mitigations, benchmark results, and evaluation procedures.
- `/signin`: OAuth authentication supporting Google and GitHub via Better Auth.
- `/shared/[id]`: Cryptographically verified read-only public consultation viewer.

### 3.2 Backend API Routes
- `POST /api/chat`: Core streaming consultation route with citation verification and RAG injection.
- `GET/POST /api/cases`: Case thread listing and persistence with multi-tenant row-level user isolation.
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/matters`: Litigation matter docketing CRUD.
- `POST /api/cases/documents/upload`: Secure document attachment route with strict MIME whitelisting (`application/pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `text/plain`), 10MB limits, and path traversal sanitization.
- `GET /api/shared/[id]`: Shareable snapshot delivery.
- `GET/POST /api/auth/[...all]`: Better Auth handler backed by Neon Kysely adapter.

---

## 4. Verification Evidence & Benchmarks

### 4.1 Automated Test Suite
- **Total Test Suites:** 37 test files
- **Total Tests:** 728 passing automated tests (0 failing, 45 skipped live integration tests)
- **Test Framework:** Vitest with Node environment
- **Security Coverage:** Multi-tenant case isolation, upload extension validation, path traversal prevention, CSRF protection, and SSRF prevention on external web calls.

### 4.2 Legal Benchmark Metrics (`benchmarks/legal-qa.jsonl`)
- **Benchmark Suite:** Curated Indian legal questions spanning BNS, IPC, BNSS, CrPC, BSA, IEA, Constitution, Contract Act, DPDP Act 2023, and Arbitration Act.
- **Section Identification Recall:** 94.0% on standard 50-item benchmark.
- **Citation Precision:** 97.8% verified authentic against Indian bare acts.
- **Adversarial Trap Case Resistance:** 100% on temporal transition trap cases (correctly refusing to apply BNS retroactively to pre-July 2024 offences).

---

## 5. Security & Threat Model (STRIDE)
- **Spoofing:** Handled via Better Auth session cookies with `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, and `Secure` attributes.
- **Tampering:** Multi-tenant query isolation enforcing `.where("userId", "=", user.id)` on all case and document queries.
- **Repudiation:** Audit logging on matter mutations and shared link generations.
- **Information Disclosure:** Strict Content Security Policy (CSP), elimination of sensitive keys in client bundles, and document upload sanitization.
- **Denial of Service:** Fast fallback parallel statutory lookup (<200ms), file size caps (10MB), and rate limiting.
- **Elevation of Privilege:** Strict session-checked API routes with 401 Unauthorized redirects.

---

## 6. How Independent Evaluators Can Audit This System
1. **Clone & Install:**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Pratyushhhx01/LawBite.git
   cd LawBite
   npm install
   ```
2. **Execute Full Test Suite:**
   ```bash
   npm run test
   ```
3. **Run Legal Evaluation Benchmark:**
   ```bash
   npm run eval:legal
   ```
4. **Audit Architecture & Threat Models:**
   Inspect `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`, `docs/RAG_PIPELINE.md`, and `docs/decisions/`.
5. **Inspect Live Production Application:**
   Navigate to https://law-bite.vercel.app and review the Trust Center at https://law-bite.vercel.app/trust.
